{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A structured black blazer, tailored fit, knee-length hem, charcoal hex #36454F, wool blend.
High-waisted dark denim trousers, straight leg cut, ankle length, deep indigo hex #192024, sturdy cotton twill.
A crisp white button-down blouse, classic point collar, hip length, pure white hex #FFFFFF, breathable poplin.
Black leather ankle boots, square toe, mid-calf height with a low block heel, matte black leather hex #000000.
This outfit honors the request for something restrained and classic by choosing a structured blazer over flashy stage clothes, grounding the look in dark denim that is versatile for standing in a crowded club. The crisp white blouse adds a touch of timeless elegance without being overly formal or revealing, ensuring the wearer feels put-together amidst the noise of a rock concert. The sturdy ankle boots provide necessary stability and comfort for navigating the venue while maintaining a sleek silhouette suitable for an evening out."}
